scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:install && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist: node scripts/modules.mjs --base && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run desktop:install && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start -w server
